prompt: Announce Carol from accounting's retirement party (34 years) as a WWE farewell match. Her music hits one last time.
response:
**🎤 WWE-STYLE RETIREMENT ANNOUNCEMENT FOR CAROL FROM ACCOUNTING 🎤**

*(Lights dim. The crowd erupts as the familiar opening chords of Carol’s entrance theme blast through the speakers. Pyro explodes. The announcer’s voice booms over the PA system…)*

**ANNOUNCER:**
*"LADIES AND GENTLEMEN… THE MOMENT YOU’VE ALL BEEN WAITING FOR! After 34 YEARS of unrelenting dedication, razor-sharp spreadsheets, and an iron grip on the company’s financial destiny… IT’S TIME TO SAY GOODBYE TO THE QUEEN OF THE LEDGER, THE UNDISPUTED CHAMPION OF QUARTERLY REPORTS… CAROL ‘THE NUMBER CRUSHER’ FROM ACCOUNTING!"*

*(Spotlight hits Carol as she strides down the aisle in a custom-made robe—bedazzled with dollar signs, a calculator belt, and a championship title that reads "34-YEAR VETERAN." The crowd loses it. She steps into the ring—er, the break room—and raises her hands, soaking in the adoration.)*

**ANNOUNCER (CONT’D):**
*"That’s right, folks! Tonight, we bear witness to the FINAL CHAPTER in the legendary career of a woman who didn’t just balance the books—she BALANCED THE SCALES OF JUSTICE! From audits that struck fear into the hearts of expense reports to last-minute tax filings that saved the company MILLIONS, Carol’s legacy is etched in the annals of corporate history!"*

*(Dramatic pause. The music swells.)*

*"But all great things must come to an end. And tonight… CAROL STEPS AWAY FROM THE RING… FOR GOOD!"*

*(The crowd gasps. A single tear rolls down Carol’s cheek as she clutches her stapler—her signature weapon—one last time.)*

**ANNOUNCER (EMOTIONAL):**
*"So raise your coffee mugs, your calculators, your ‘I Survived Another Audit’ trophies… and give it up for the woman who made numbers her BUSINESS… CAROL ‘THE SPREADSHEET SLAYER’ FROM ACCOUNTING!"*

*(The music hits its crescendo. Confetti (or shredded expense reports) rains down. Carol takes a victory lap around the office, high-fiving colleagues, before dramatically pointing to the sky—signaling her next adventure: RETIREMENT.)*

**ANNOUNCER (FINAL CALL):**
*"THIS… IS THE END OF AN ERA! GOODNIGHT, EVERYONE!"*

*(Cue fireworks. Or at least a really nice cake.)*

**🎉 HAPPY RETIREMENT, CAROL! 🎉** 💰📊🏆
